sentence_stem: If I had studied harder at school,
correct_completion: I would be working in a better job now.
full_sentence: If I had studied harder at school, I would be working in a better job now.
acceptable_variants: I might be working in a better job now.
I would be earning more money now.

options.text: I work in a better job now.
options.why_wrong: A simple present tense states a real fact and does not express an unreal past condition with a present result.

options.text: I had a better job now.
options.why_wrong: A past simple verb does not express a hypothetical present result after a past condition.

options.text: I would be working in a better job now.
I would have worked in a better job by now.
options.why_wrong: 'Would have' plus a past form points to a past result, which does not fit the present time expression 'now'.

grammar_focus: Mixed conditionals: past condition with present result
explanation: A mixed conditional links an unreal past condition with an unreal present result. The past perfect appears in the if-clause, and 'would' plus a continuous infinitive appears in the main clause to describe the present situation.
translation: Si hubiera estudiado más duro en la escuela, ahora estaría trabajando en un mejor puesto.
